description: Check that text matches a hash. Name the algorithm when you know it. Without it the algorithm follows from the hash: 8, 32, 40, 64 or 128 hex characters mean CRC32, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512, and an integer means CRC32 in decimal; whirlpool, sha3_256, sha3_512 and blake2b share those lengths and must be named. Answers match, algorithm and computed. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

algorithm.description: Optional for the first five, required for the rest.

name: verify_hash
title: Verify a hash
